Anchor.description:
Where a block's text is written: the README's anchor grammar, the same
string the rendered page carries in `data-ascribe-source` and
`data-ascribe-via`.

source.description:
`<path>:<first>-<last>`: the file's content path, percent-encoded by
segment, and the block's first and last lines, from 1.

via.description:
The includes the block came through, outermost first, each
`<path>:<line>`. Empty for a block written in the page itself.

BaseInfo.description: The base of a comparison, in the report.

merge_base.description:
The merge base of that commit and `HEAD`, which the comparison reads;
`null` with `--base-exact`, which reads `commit`.

requested.description: The revision asked for, or the default branch used.

after.description:
For a removed block, and a moved block's old place: the block of the
new version it came after, among its siblings. Absent when it was
first.

now.description: Where it's written now: every kind but `removed`.

parent.description:
For a removed block, and a moved block's old place: the block of the
new version it was inside. Absent at the top of the page.

text.description:
For a removed block, its text, whitespace collapsed, so it can be
shown where it was.

was.description: Where it was written: every kind but `added`.

words.description: For changed prose, the words that differ.

oneOf.description: The same block is somewhere else.

ChangedPage.description: A changed page in the list: `ascribe diff`'s page without its block changes, and its title.

because.description:
The other changed files the page's change can come from: fragments it
includes and pages its links take a title or a heading from, in path
order; then the snippets whose code changed, by address
(`code:app.py#main`); and `ascribe.toml` (last) when the content model
is a cause.

counts.description: How many changes of each kind.

own_file_changed.description: Whether the page's own file changed (or exists on one side only).

page_changed.description:
What changed about the page itself besides its blocks, in this
order: `title`, `frontmatter`, `availability` (the page-level one),
and `route`. Empty for an added or removed page.

route.description: Its route: the new one, or for a removed page the old one.

status.description:
Whether the build publishes it only now, only before, or in both
with a difference.

title.description: The page's title; `null` when it has none.

Counts.description: How many changes of each kind a page has.

added.description: Blocks only in the new version.

removed.description: Blocks only in the old version.

PageStatus.description: Whether a page is new, gone, or different.

oneOf.description: The build publishes it now, and didn't before.
The build published it before, and doesn't now.
The build publishes it in both, and it differs.

Words.description:
The words that differ inside a changed block of prose. Ranges are
`[start, end)` in characters (Unicode scalar values) of each side's
`text`, which is the block's text with whitespace collapsed.

now.description: Ranges in `now_text`: words added or replacing others.

was.description: Ranges in `was_text`: words removed or replaced.

base.description: The base compared with; `null` when there is none.

build.description: The build the pages are of.

contentRoot.description: The content root, as a path, which the pages' paths are relative to.

pages.description:
The changed pages, in path order: `ascribe diff`'s pages without their
`changes`, each with its `title`.

problem.description:
Why there are no pages to list, when that isn't because nothing
changed.
